overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating and evaluating dialogues that transition from chit-chat to task-oriented scenarios. It uses human evaluation extensively but no automatic metrics. The main contribution is the SalesBot dataset and framework. The human evaluation was comprehensive with three distinct tasks covering different aspects of dialogue quality.
